Nabaahat may also be associated with the traditional Arabic poetry that celebrated the coming of the seasonal winds and their calming influence.

The arrival of a new life is seen as a gift from Allah and a reminder of His infinite mercy and compassion. The name serves as a daily reminder to seek the peaceful blessings and soothing comfort that come from being close to the Creator. Through this name, parents can also pray that their child grows to be a calming influence in the world, with a gentle and compassionate heart.
